<thought>To find the appropriate retrosynthetic template, I will search the template catalog for reactions that, in the forward direction, break “ketones” and “trimethylsilyl” groups and form a “C-C double bonds” group, which matches the Peterson elimination description.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketones", "trimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["C-C double bonds"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
